one_liner: Team chat and collaboration app with channels, DMs, calls, integrations, and apps platform.
access_notes: you can self-serve create/install apps and get working credentials; publishing a Public app to the CAKE.com Marketplace requires review.
mcp_notes: Pumble hosts an MCP server to connect agents (Claude, Gemini, etc.) using your app key plus user/bot token; tools map to selected scopes.
blocker_notes: for a public OAuth app listing; private installs are immediate

evidence.quote: Pumble uses OAuth2… generate an access token… returns ‘accessToken’ and ‘botToken’.
Every Request to Pumble API must be sent with two headers: 1. x-app-token… 2. token: The access token of the user or bot.
This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests… Available on all plans.
When you create an incoming webhook, you receive a unique URL by which you can send a JSON payload with the message text…
If you wish to make your app Public, it needs to go through the review process… ‘Private’ app can be published immediately.
